case: Critical relay in the reported 20-node WRSN case
source: Author-reported case summaries already stated in the manuscript

responsibility.other_routes: C1 and C3 are shown as an aggregate; their individual resource-conditioned shares are not supplied or inferred

standard.ranking_interpretation: Each of the three complete routes C1, C2 and C3 receives 1/3 for this task dividend; standard sharing cannot rank the routes by recovery difficulty

resource_conditioned.ranking_interpretation: The complete route C2 receives 0.52, exceeding the 0.48 aggregate of C1 and C3; thus it exceeds either route individually without inferring their individual shares

redistribution.interpretation: A conservative correspondence between the two responsibility allocations; not a physical flow of energy, service, or time
redistribution.construction: Common retained mass plus the net increase in C2 share; no individual shares for the other routes are inferred

local_recovery_probe.denominator: Service committed by C2 to the associated task
local_recovery_probe.derivation: kappa = 1 - restored service / committed service; hence restored fraction = 1 - 0.85 = 0.15

units: Fractions; the two panels use different denominators
execution_comparison: The separately supplied energy checkpoints and named-path availability for this same case are stored in case_execution.json; attribution alone does not establish the execution outcome
uncertainty: No uncertainty intervals or repeated-run distribution are supplied for this individual case
signed_dividend_note: The separate redundancy dividend -0.8 belongs to a different interaction and is not multiplied by the 0.52 task share
